name: Gidazepam
summary: Gidazepam, also known as hydazepam or hidazepam, is a drug which is an atypical benzodiazepine derivative, developed in the Soviet Union. It is a selectively anxiolytic benzodiazepine. It also has therapeutic value in the management of certain cardiovascular disorders.

pharmacology.text: Gidazepam and several of its analogs, in contrast to other benzodiazepines, are comparatively more selective agonists of TSPO (formerly the peripheral benzodiazepine receptor) than the benzodiazepine receptor. Gidazepam acts as a prodrug to its active metabolite 7-bromo-2,3-dihydro-5-phenyl-1H-1,4-benzodiazepin-2-one (desalkylgidazepam or bromo-nordazepam).

uses.en: It is prescribed in some former Soviet countries, such as Russia and Ukraine, for anxiety.
uses.zh: 它在俄羅斯、烏克蘭等部分前蘇聯國家作為抗焦慮藥處方使用。
uses.zhHans: 它在俄罗斯、乌克兰等部分前苏联国家作为抗焦虑药处方使用。

sideEffects.en: It is described as less sedating than many benzodiazepines, but it can still cause drowsiness and dizziness. Like other benzodiazepines, regular use can lead to dependence, and stopping suddenly can cause dangerous withdrawal, including seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 它被描述為鎮靜作用比許多苯二氮平類弱，但仍可能造成嗜睡與頭暈。和其他苯二氮平類一樣，長期使用可能導致依賴，突然停藥可能引發危險的戒斷，包括癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它被描述为镇静作用比许多苯二氮平类弱，但仍可能造成嗜睡与头晕。和其他苯二氮平类一样，长期使用可能导致依赖，突然停药可能引发危险的戒断，包括癫痫发作。

fact.en: Gidazepam is a prodrug: the body cuts off its long side chain to release the active benzodiazepine desalkylgidazepam, which does most of the work.
fact.zh: Gidazepam 是一種前驅藥：身體會切掉它的長側鏈，釋出真正有活性的苯二氮平類 desalkylgidazepam，主要作用都由後者負責。
fact.zhHans: Gidazepam 是一种前驱药：身体会切掉它的长侧链，发布真正有活性的苯二氮平类 desalkylgidazepam，主要作用都由后者负责。
